references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, rules are given for valuing and redeeming unclean animals that have been vowed to the Lord, with the same principle of adding a fifth upon redemption.
The principle of adding a fifth (חֲמִשִׁתוֹ) in cases of restitution or redemption is also found here in connection with holy things.
The same principle applies when one must add a fifth to replace something holy that was eaten by mistake.
The addition of a fifth is also mentioned in the redemption of tithes.
Redemption (פָדָה) of firstborns from unclean animals, especially the donkey, with reference to ransom money.
Rules for redeeming firstborns from unclean animals, with a set value for the ransom money.
